name: DisProt
description: Manually curated gold-standard database of experimentally validated disordered regions

name: MobiDB
description: Disorder and mobility annotations across UniProt (predicted + curated)

name: Protein Ensemble Database (PED)
description: Primary repository of deposited structural ensembles of IDPs

name: AlphaFold DB (pLDDT as disorder proxy)
description: Low-confidence (pLDDT) regions widely used as a disorder predictor - not an ensemble

name: CAID (Critical Assessment of Intrinsic Disorder)
description: Community benchmark of disorder & binding predictors; round 3 (2025) dominated by protein-language-model methods

name: ALBATROSS
description: Predicts IDR ensemble dimensions (Rg; Re; scaling exponent) from sequence; proteome-scale

name: STARLING
description: Latent diffusion model generating coarse-grained IDR ensembles in seconds (Nature 2026)

name: CALVADOS
description: Coarse-grained model for IDPs and condensates

name: logos / RFdiffusion IDR binder design
description: De novo protein binders to disordered regions (Science & Nature 2025)

name: DropScan
description: Computer-vision high-throughput screen for small molecules modulating condensates

name: Topos-1 / Topos-Bind
description: Company foundation models for IDP ensembles and small-molecule binding (company-reported benchmarks)
